mapper.select: SELECT ADDRESS FROM INFO_BOARD WHERE ADDRESS IS NOT NULL

SELECT * FROM INFO_BOARD WHERE 1=1
AND LOCATION_TYPE = #{type}
AND ADDRESS LIKE #{city} || '%'
AND ADDRESS LIKE '%' || #{district} || '%'
AND AI_TAGS LIKE '%' || #{tag} || '%'
ORDER BY INFO_NO DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO INFO_BOARD ( INFO_NO, CONTENT_ID, INFO_NAME, ADDRESS, TEL, IMG_URL, THUMB_URL, HOMEPAGE, LAT, LNG, OPEN_TIME, REST_DAY, PARKING, MENU, INFO_BODY, AI_TAGS, AI_NOTE, LOCATION_TYPE, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_INFO_BOARD_NO.NEXTVAL, #{contentId}, #{infoName}, #{address}, #{tel}, #{imgUrl}, #{thumbUrl}, #{homepage}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{openTime}, #{restDay}, #{parking}, #{menu}, #{infoBody}, #{aiTags}, #{aiNote}, #{locationType}, SYSDATE )
